title: 港股午评：恒指跌1.75% 科指跌1.87% 科网股、保险股普跌 黄金股逆势上涨
summary: 8月6日午间，港股三大指数集体下挫，恒生指数跌1.75%至25,463点，恒生科技指数跌1.87%。科网股普跌：阿里巴巴、百度跌超3%，小米、京东跌超2%；黄金股逆势走强，潼关黄金涨超6%。
why: 科网板块普跌直接压制持仓中的腾讯、阿里、美团、携程等港股仓位；触发原因为美国7月ADP就业大幅不及预期（仅增4.4万），降息预期升温但对科技股短期构成情绪性抛压。Sell put 持仓需关注行权价保护空间。

title: U.S. July ADP Employment: Private Sector Adds Only 44,000 Jobs, Far Below 75,000 Estimate
summary: ADP National Employment Report shows U.S. private payrolls grew by just 44,000 in July 2026, sharply missing the 75,000 consensus forecast and down from June's 95,000. Services added 47,000 while goods-producing sectors shed 3,000 jobs. Annual pay growth held at 4.4% for job-stayers.
why: 就业数据骤降强化市场降息预期，短期利多美债、压制美元，但港股科技股当日跟跌体现情绪传导。Sell put 策略中美股标的（NVDA、TSLA、COST 等）短期隐含波动率或受宏观不确定性推升，有利于期权权利金。

title: SpaceX Tumbles 14% as 911.5 Million Insider Shares Unlock on Aug. 6 — Lockup Expiry Adds $116B Float
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) shares dropped 14% on August 6 as 911.5 million insider shares became eligible for sale — more than doubling the public float. The stock had already fallen ~50% from its June intraday high of $225.64 and now trades below its IPO price of $135. Q1 revenue came in at $7.8B (+92% YoY), beating estimates but stock fell 7% on high AI-related capex.
why: 史上规模最大解禁事件之一，直接拖累美股科技情绪，对期权策略有参考价值：单一股票大规模解禁后隐含波动率往往在事件后骤降，可对标我们持仓中类似高估值科技标的（如PLTR）的期权时机窗口。

title: Oil Holds Three-Day Drop as Iran, Oman Reach Hormuz Shipping Agreement; WTI Near $75
summary: Iran and Oman agreed on a proposed shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, raising hopes of partial energy flow resumption. West Texas Intermediate held near $75/barrel after losing 11% in the week's first three sessions. Oil markets cautious as real-world implementation of the deal remains unclear.
why: 霍尔木兹局势缓和使油价从高位回落，降低通胀预期，间接支持美联储降息路径，有利于估值敏感的科技股和消费股。同时，能源成本下行对港股互联网/消费板块（美团、携程）的经营环境为正面影响。

title: AMD Q2 2026: Record Revenue $11.5B, Data Center Doubles to $6.7B — Q3 Guided to $13B on AI Demand
summary: AMD reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $11.5B (+50% YoY), with data center revenue surging 107% to $6.7B driven by EPYC server CPUs and Instinct AI GPUs. Q3 revenue guided to $13B, 2.9% above consensus. Helios rack-scale AI system (Venice CPU + MI455X GPU) entering production, with Meta and OpenAI as launch customers.
why: AMD业绩大超预期，确认AI算力需求仍极强劲，是8月26日英伟达(NVDA)财报超预期的有力先行指标。数据中心GPU翻倍增长直接支撑SK海力士/美光的HBM需求叙事；NVDA covered call 时机可继续持守。

title: 阿里巴巴发布最强千问模型Qwen3.8-Max：2.4万亿参数，全球第三方榜单排名仅次于Claude
summary: 阿里巴巴于8月3日正式发布Qwen3.8-Max，参数量达2.4万亿，采用稀疏MoE架构，是千问系列首个突破万亿参数的模型，也是首个承诺开源权重的Max级模型。128K标准上下文，特殊场景可无损扩展至1M tokens。权威第三方榜单Arena排名全球第二，仅次于Anthropic Claude系列。API已上线：输入12元/百万token。
why: 阿里AI技术突破缩小与国际顶尖模型差距，有望重估阿里云估值；持仓9988.HK/BABA方向正面，Sell put 行权价可适度下调提供安全垫。当日港股阿里逆势大涨6%，需关注后续能否持续。

title: Circle (CRCL) Slides After Morgan Stanley Slashes Price Target 64% to $38; TD Cowen Initiates at Buy $82 Same Day
summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Circle Internet Group (CRCL) to Underweight and cut its price target from $106 to $38, a 64% reduction, citing USDC supply contraction — circulating supply fell from ~$80B to ~$73B since March — and intensifying competition from tokenized money market funds backed by BlackRock, Fidelity, and State Street. Stock fell ~6% on the news. On the same day, TD Cowen initiated coverage with a Buy rating and $82 target, highlighting divergent analyst views.
why: CRCL持仓的核心风险暴露：摩根士丹利将目标价腰斩，显示USDC供给收缩已引发机构重新定价。Sell put 策略中行权价的安全边际需下调。逢高卖出covered call锁定下行保护。延续报道：GENIUS法案实施后竞争格局仍未稳定，分析师分歧极大（$38 vs $82），隐含波动率维持高位利于期权策略。

title: Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron Sell Out 2027 DRAM and HBM Capacity; AI Demand Absorbs 70% of Output
summary: Per industry sources cited by DigiTimes, all three major memory makers — Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron — have booked their entire 2027 DRAM and HBM capacity, with AI demand consuming ~70% of total DRAM output. NAND Flash is also nearing full booking through August 2026. Apple reportedly failed to secure a fourth DRAM supplier as the 2027 market closed. Consumer device DRAM allocations for 2027 will shrink noticeably as AI continues to crowd out mobile/PC demand.
why: 2027年产能全部售罄意味着SK海力士（HBM龙头）和美光/闪迪的利润能见度极高，支持估值上行；期权策略中相关标的隐含波动率或因供需紧缺持续走高，sell put 收益率保持有吸引力。供给瓶颈还将推高HBM均价，利好SK海力士做多方向。

title: SanDisk and SK Hynix Unveil Industry-First High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) Standard at FMS 2026
summary: SanDisk and SK Hynix released the first OCP technical specification for High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) — a new memory tier positioned between HBM and SSDs for AI inference workloads. HBF supports up to 512GB capacity using 8-high/16-high NAND die stacks with three bandwidth grades (0.4–3.0 TB/s). Consortium includes Google and Tenstorrent. Announced at the Future of Memory and Storage conference (FMS 2026, Santa Clara, Aug 4–6).
why: HBF标准确立标志着SanDisk（SNDK）在AI存储生态的战略地位提升，拓展其产品线从消费级NAND向高利润AI基础设施层迁移；SK海力士（南方两倍做多）是联合制定者，有望在AI推理市场获得新营收来源。此次技术标准化是长期利多，但短期催化有限。

title: 老铺黄金：跌没一个周大福——中期利润预增83%但增速骤降，股价从高点累计跌73%
summary: 老铺黄金（06181.HK）2026年上半年经调整净利润预计增长83%–85%至43.1亿–43.6亿元，营收增长60%–66%至198亿–204.5亿元；但增速较2025H1（净利润超2倍）大幅放缓，且二季度收入环比大幅下滑，触发市场失望情绪。7月28日单日股价暴跌23.76%，29日再跌4.83%，自2025年7月历史高点（1108港元）已累计下跌约73%，市值蒸发超一个周大福。
why: 高增长故事被打破，黄金价格从高点回落（近期在4000美元/盎司附近波动）叠加需求疲软，未来增长预期被重新定价。若持有老铺黄金相关期权或正股，行权价/止损需重新评估。机构纷纷下调目标价（海通国际目标553港元），当前股价仍有进一步寻底可能；延续报道：8月正式中期业绩即将发布。
